founder.label: Founder style
founder.opening_guidance: Start with a concrete decision, surprise, or lesson from building.

researcher.label: Researcher style
researcher.opening_guidance: Lead with a finding, tension in the evidence, or a precise question.

engineer.label: Engineer style
engineer.opening_guidance: Open with a system behavior, failure mode, or implementation lesson.

career_journey.label: Career journey style
career_journey.opening_guidance: Begin with a real transition, skill shift, or milestone you can verify in memory.
